en.Je suis Akim, data analyst en formation: I am Akim, a data analyst in AI training. I turn your data into fast and measurable decisions.
en.Étudiant en 2ème année de Data & Intelli: 2nd-year student in Data & Artificial Intelligence at INSI Antananarivo, I am building solid expertise at the intersection of data analysis, machine learning, and visualization.
en.Je transforme des jeux de données comple: I turn complex datasets into actionable insights, whether through predictive models, interactive dashboards, or in-depth exploratory analyses.
en.Mon objectif : intégrer une équipe data: My goal: to join an ambitious data team where I can bring immediate value while continuing to grow.
en.Je vous apporte des solutions sur mesure: I provide tailor-made solutions to turn your data into strategic assets.
en.Transformez vos données brutes en inform: Transform your raw data into strategic insights. Identify key trends and opportunities for informed decisions.
en.Tableaux de bord interactifs pour un sui: Interactive dashboards for real-time monitoring. Designed with Power BI, Tableau, Python.
en.Éliminez les tâches répétitives et gagne: Eliminate repetitive tasks and boost productivity. Process automation (Excel, reporting, scraping) with Python.
en.Développement de modèles prédictifs pour: Development of predictive models to forecast trends, detect anomalies, and optimize performance.
en.Je suis libre pour toute collaboration: I am free for any collaboration
en.Que ce soit pour un projet, un stage ou: Whether for a project, internship, or freelance assignment, I am open to discussing your ideas and needs. Contact me to talk about it!
en.suis Akim, passionné par l’analyse de do: am Akim, passionate about data analysis and Artificial Intelligence. I turn complex data into clear and actionable information to help make better decisions. I develop analyses and models capable of revealing trends, anticipating behaviors, and simplifying data understanding.
en.Mon approche est simple : rendre la donn: My approach is simple: make data useful, understandable, and impact-oriented.
en.Message envoyé ! Je vous répondrai rapid: Message sent! I will reply soon.
